summary: Newegg Commerce, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing its second-quarter 2026 financial results via press release. The report details net sales of $320.4 million (down 8.1% YoY), GMV of $403.2 million (down 3.9%), and net income of $2.2 million. Management discussed supply constraints, AI initiatives, and the extension of credit agreements for 90 days to November 25, 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no M&A, tender, or strategic event is involved.
